tasks.notes: Yes: returning within 24 hours to a percentage that passed its gates counts as part of the rollback, not a ramp step. cross-section: Cutover plan (Tuesday/Wednesday daytime rule) and the week 44 status entry (24-hour reading).

tasks.prompt: Summarise what has to be true before Corvidex can move from 25% to its next ramp step, including when that step may take place.

rubric.text: All quality gates green at the current percentage for three days in a row; a gate showing "not enough data" does not count as green.
The freshness gate must have been green for 14 days in a row on all three storefronts, not the usual 3, before going past 25%.
The step may only happen on a Tuesday or Wednesday between 09:00 and 15:00 UK time.
The step is announced in #search-programme at least one working day ahead.

No ramp step happens during the peak freeze (2026-11-16 to 2026-12-04); the peak traffic level is still undecided, and until the steering group decides the plan holds 25% through the freeze with the 50% step on 2026-12-08.
